notes: Chat now shows the time above each burst of messages.
Tap a chat message to see when it was sent.
Getting honked now plays a goose animation. Turn it off in Account → Gameplay.
The game log now says who honked whom.
New setting: keep the I / II markers on your starting settlements all game.
Finished games stay in your Active list, marked Complete, until you've seen the result.
Spectators can pin a game to their Games tab from the game menu.
Moving the robber takes one confirm: when there's a choice of who to rob, you confirm after picking the player.
New setting: keep the road tool selected after placing a road, while you can afford another.
Investor: you can hold at most six investment tokens.
Scout: Wheat and Sheep can stand in for each other when buying a dev card. Ore can't be swapped.
Scout: buying a dev card now opens your hand so you tap the cards to pay with.
Player details now show a Carpenter's bought victory points.
Chat time headers now sit above their messages, and the sender's name repeats under each one.
Tapping a chat message shows a shorter time, and it slides open and closed.
Your chat messages appear the moment you send them.
Gambler: keep or reroll from the status banner, which shows the cards the roll would pay you.
Trade and Roll / End turn are now the same width.
Curio Collector picks now use a compact banner, so you can still see the board.
The Ritualist picker can be minimized while you check the board.
You'll now see what's new after each update.
Knight, Road Building and Year of Plenty can now be undone. A knight can be taken back until you place the robber.
Tapping Road Building goes straight to placing your free roads.
End turn now has its own muted color, so it's easier to tell apart from Roll.
Tapping Knight goes straight to moving the robber.
Some reserved words, like resource and game terms, can no longer be used as usernames.
